title: Mamie Desdune, blues pianist
summary: Allen asks about pianist Mamie Desdune; Williams knows a Desdune relative and will ask.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Who played piano: the pianists musicians remembered

blocks.x: I know what I wanted to ask you. Did you know Mamie Dad's doing them? She was a piano player.
Desdune. She played mostly blues, you know?
Might be relative to this boy. I don't know. I know him. He's a Desdune.
Well, I think she lived up right around here. Yeah. You ask him for me, will you?
She was a piano player and they have a blues that they play called Mamie's Blues. Or the 219 blues.
I like him. He lived up here. He used to be a piano player himself but he don't play anymore. He's been all up the country playing. I ask the daddy to me. I do.
